title: Archive #7546 rechart trial and 1196 feasibility handoff (no κ gain)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Archive one completed contact-level nomination study against #7546, preserving the memory failure and the explicitly approved corrected successor. **No nominee or new κ was obtained.** This completed source archive is offered for review; it does not request frontier adoption.

The first run stopped on `MemoryError` before any expansion. The corrected bitmask implementation completed all **2,192/2,192** frozen expansion keys (1,096 current frame IDs, one input sweep then one output sweep) without a floating nominee. Its historical scientific job recorded **16.080671317s wall, 16.032971s aggregate CPU, 539,992 KiB conservative summed peak RSS**, within the unchanged limits. The original failed budget flag and receipts remain intact. These figures cover the specified job, not total agent, consultation or publication costs.

The package also preserves the source-only route assessment: the fixed-body boundary concavity reduction, the uncovered mixed-orientation limitation, and a concrete 1196 paid-path inspection that does not supply the 1459 cache promise or the retained 885 owner transition. These findings do not exclude all joint contact changes or every changed producer. Floating-zero cuts are not exact optimum certificates.

Package: [`research/p104-7546-contact-rechart-handoff`](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/tree/321a189ad84772512798e5ec74a25547447fa054/research/p104-7546-contact-rechart-handoff). It contains 85 byte-preserved historical files, both 20-file freezes, six new archive/analysis files, exact source pins, retained notices and selected raw receipts. Historical launchers are inert evidence with expired execution authority. There is intentionally **no registered `VERIFY.json` or default scientific replay**. No private Pro/browser transcripts are included.

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Task/scope: `p104-side-correction`, revision-8 priorities, canonical [#7111 finding/release](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19606060).

Scientific source: #7546 at `99438c43df7aac1e5dbcc43c1578fcd886c119ec`, canonical word `bdecd5cc1cb9f164dc695ce07a07d5d44e9961996fcdfa4d77b4092fecbda745`. Original/corrected freeze digests are respectively `a5dcf94d69936c501ec2d630cdc45b30425756f79aeedee7730114ba877c265a` and `7d89fcb67f70d56bc3b8a4d6f457a88436181fb85f3533ea4603ece11d531d18`.

Scope is **changed to a publication-only historical handoff at the donor's request**; the original new-κ objective remains unmet. The source trial allowed unprotected main-body contacts while fixing main boundaries, unlike the older all-main-fixed trial. It also differs from #7574's fixed visits and external boundaries. The normalized reconstruction/paid-edge method and protected constructor reuse #7122/#7124; their old gains are not claimed anew. #7579/#7580's information-price and fixed-producer hypotheses are kept separate from the unproved 1196 changed-producer path. Exact heads and hypotheses are in `REASSESSMENT.md`.

The separate #7556 review and the #7481 predecessor gain are not duplicated or claimed here. A bounded inventory of this investigation's canonical records found no other completed root-owned package explicitly awaiting submission; older released findings and the public #7480 review remain linked in their existing threads.

## Validation

Python **3.12.3**, Linux, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/p104-7546-contact-rechart-handoff/INTEGRITY.py
python3 -I -O -B research/p104-7546-contact-rechart-handoff/INTEGRITY.py
```

Both pass. The checker hashes the historical manifest, authenticates both frozen closures, checks recorded coverage/resource flags, and compares the new source selection with the literal archived JSON. It never imports or executes the archived instructions, compiler, optimizer, native code or launchers.

An independent AI archive review identified an empty-selection false pass in the new metadata checker. The final checker enforces the fixed five-role, eleven-neighborhood, four-collateral and 85-file denominators; the previously failing empty-role corruption now rejects under optimized Python. Empty-frame and wrong-clock corruptions also reject. No historical scientific artifact was changed by this repair.

All **91 committed regular files** were compared byte-for-byte with the reviewed working files, with parent main verified. A fresh read-only, Git-free copy passes archival integrity. `git diff --cached --check` passed. These are custody/publication checks, not a new independent scientific replay or supplier qualification.

Unrun/outside scope: another source experiment; any candidate physical phase/all-column/adjoint/all-width, dirty-public/COPY/74-erasure-channel qualification; complete changed ordinary/stock/grid/precision/tape/compiler/BIT/caller/58-outer/two-price/ceiling admission. All five inherited premises remain. No human or proof-kernel acceptance, selected-frontier change, merge or closure of others' work is asserted.

## Credit

Retain 1337isnot1337/OpenAI Codex's alpha-expansion method; Rohan Arun's #7122/#7124 boundary reconstruction and #7113 caller; ToikY's #7546/#7544; DreamingOfClouds' #7542; CubeJerry's scoped rechart/cache bounds; the #7334/#7480/#7481 lineage and all retained source notices. Apache-2.0 sources and licenses are preserved.

Prepared for Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Pro/Codex assistance and the authorized **20 GPT-6.1-Terra medium agents** for research/static review, archive preparation and publication checks. AI review is distinguished from independent human/formal review.

## Open next questions

See the [concrete handoff questions](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/321a189ad84772512798e5ec74a25547447fa054/research/p104-7546-contact-rechart-handoff/README.md#open-next-questions). The smallest useful new artifact is a literal funded coupled exchange, or an admitted preparation/cache/retirement implementation, with exact events, displaced-input returns, every paid leg and complete target debit. That artifact is missing. A new prompt, wider label set or repetition of the closed sweep does not supply it. Research is wrapped; this PR authorizes no further run.
